title: SD-MT346-SurrealExclusiveEndToEndGate
clause: Prove WP017 and the Handshake runtime are completely SurrealDB-dependent with no PostgreSQL authority path.

scope.summary: GOAL: Prove WP017 and the Handshake runtime are completely SurrealDB-dependent with no PostgreSQL authority path. This contract implements Master Spec v02.205. PostgreSQL, PgPool, sqlx-postgres, PostgreSQL SQL/DDL/RLS/LISTEN-NOTIFY/JSONB/pgvector and DATABASE_URL are forbidden as product-runtime authority. EventLedger semantic contracts remain authoritative but their persistence is SurrealDB-native. The current PostgreSQL database contains no valuable live information; no PostgreSQL connection, import, fallback, or proof path is allowed.
forbidden_paths: SQLite authority, cache, fallback or proof paths
acceptance_criteria: A clean machine/runtime starts Handshake with only managed SurrealDB, executes representative Notes, agent-session, MT-dispatch, worktree-volume, annotation, knowledge and replay workflows, restarts and reproduces state.

Handshake contains no PostgreSQL mode and never probes PostgreSQL; PostgreSQL absent/unreachable cannot affect runtime, and legacy DATABASE_URL injection is rejected as forbidden configuration rather than interpreted.

Independent scans and compile-feature inspection find zero unclassified PostgreSQL/sqlx/PgPool/PostgresDatabase runtime dependencies and zero PostgreSQL proof targets anywhere in product or test code.

Real record-user privacy, atomic EventLedger, live-query reconnect, backup/restore and fresh-initialization and PostgreSQL-absence proofs pass; validator receives the complete remediation and evidence map.

The final gate proves managed-project/Locus and Notes/Loom/Castkit closures on real SurrealDB. MT-410 REJECT leaves no Turso dependency; MT-410 ADOPT proves the bounded WpLocalStore is disposable, cannot hold canonical content and cannot change Surreal truth under loss, retry or corruption.
proof_targets: Run the named focused Rust tests against a real disposable Handshake-managed SurrealDB namespace/database.
Run repository tripwires for PostgreSQL/sqlx/PgPool/PostgresDatabase and classify every remaining hit as historical documentation or a removal target; no connected legacy path is allowed.
Run with a scoped CARGO_TARGET_DIR under ../Handshake_Artifacts/handshake-cargo-target/ and retain measured output outside the repo.
expected_tests: A clean machine/runtime starts Handshake with only managed SurrealDB, executes representative Notes, agent-session, MT-dispatch, worktree-volume, annotation, knowledge and replay workflows, restarts and reproduces state.

Handshake contains no PostgreSQL mode and never probes PostgreSQL; PostgreSQL absent/unreachable cannot affect runtime, and legacy DATABASE_URL injection is rejected as forbidden configuration rather than interpreted.

Independent scans and compile-feature inspection find zero unclassified PostgreSQL/sqlx/PgPool/PostgresDatabase runtime dependencies and zero PostgreSQL proof targets anywhere in product or test code.

Real record-user privacy, atomic EventLedger, live-query reconnect, backup/restore and fresh-initialization and PostgreSQL-absence proofs pass; validator receives the complete remediation and evidence map.

risk_if_missed: A remaining PostgreSQL physical assumption can create a hidden second authority, false completion proof, privacy bypass, replay divergence or runtime startup dependency.

risks: A PostgreSQL path survives behind a feature flag, fixture, direct pool consumer or fallback.
A root/system SurrealDB session makes privacy tests pass while bypassing record permissions.
EventLedger or projection behavior changes during physical-store translation.
A hidden PostgreSQL connection, feature, fixture or proof path survives the pivot.
minimum_controls: Compile and runtime tripwires plus exhaustive classified source inventory.
Privacy proof uses authenticated record users and ResourceBroker, never administrative credentials.
Real-runtime atomicity, replay, restart and reconciliation proofs.
Zero PostgreSQL connectivity, dependencies, runtime modes, fixtures or proof targets; fresh SurrealDB initialization is the only authority path.

research_provenance.source: Official SurrealDB Rust SDK, permissions/RLS, live-query and SurrealKit rollout documentation checked 2026-08-15; project product-code and completed-packet audits recorded in WP017 refinement.
research_provenance.selected_approach: Handshake-managed SurrealDB, official Rust SDK, SCHEMAFULL typed records, record-user permissions plus ResourceBroker, live queries, SurrealKit rollouts, preserved EventLedger semantics.
rejected_options: Re-labeling historical PostgreSQL validation as SurrealDB proof
